intent: After one accepted request, another voice broke into the channel asking where the package was going. That convinced me the beacon may save people and also draw them. I warn the Pennsylvania station not to announce the number of doses, not to use a full name, and not to leave exterior lights on when the drone approaches. I arrange a later check-in because I do not want this to be the last human voice I hear.
emotion: relieved, careful, technically precise, hopeful, explicit about what remains secondhand
